prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A cozy, warmly lit living room scene featuring three young adults sitting closely together on a plush, pastel pink sofa. The group consists of two women and one man, all smiling and laughing as they watch something off-screen, creating a sense of camaraderie and joy. The woman in the center wears a bright yellow blouse and a beige skirt, sitting cross-legged and leaning comfortably into her friends. The man on the left sports a light gray t-shirt and patterned pants, his curly hair and relaxed posture adding to the casual, friendly atmosphere. The woman on the right has a natural afro hairstyle and wears a soft peach-colored top and matching pants, her body language open and engaged.

The background is a stylish, symmetrical living room with warm, peach-toned walls and deep red curtains framing a large window that lets in soft, natural daylight. On either side of the window, there are mid-century modern wooden sideboards topped with glowing orb lamps, adding to the ambient lighting. Above each sideboard hangs a large, whimsical portrait—one of a man and one of a woman—each rendered in a playful, slightly surreal style that adds character to the space.

The color palette is dominated by warm hues: peach, pink, yellow, and soft browns, with pops of green from the window view and fresh flowers on the left side table. The lighting is soft and golden, evoking a late afternoon or early evening glow, with practical lamps enhancing the cozy mood. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, creating an intimate, inviting composition with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the trio while gently blurring the background. The overall style is cinematic and contemporary, blending elements of retro decor with modern sensibilities to create a vibrant, joyful, and welcoming atmosphere.
